title: Find a Friend
headline: Find a Friendo
tagline: Find a Friendo is a platform to connect with a friend or professional to talk to you.
about: Mental Illnesses are becoming more common throughout our nation’s colleges. And, college therapy just isn’t working anymore because the college psychiatry system fails. According to proven research, talking about your problems with someone can clear one’s headspace and begin the growth process. Find a Friendo application enables you to connect with someone who will listen to your problems, whether that may be another student pursuing therapy or a trained professional, by keeping the conversation confidential between both of them. Explore more on

blocks.heading: Challenges
blocks.lead: The main challenging task was to create a platform that allows users to have a conversation via group chat with each other by 24 hours anonymous. We had to make the application in a way that permits users to join the right kind of group chat out of hundreds of group chats according to their issues.
blocks.body: Our dedicated developer team managed to add functionality in which users can sign up on Find a Friendo. The information like with whom they are talking, what have they chatted, what help did will remain confidential.

blocks.heading: Core Features
blocks.lead: Users can book the appointment and connect with the licensed therapists to get help from them regarding their issues.
blocks.body: With this feature, users can join different types the group chats available in the application. User can join any which is close to their hearts.

blocks.heading: Solutions
blocks.lead: Our most experienced developers were working dedicatedly to creating a feature in the application that helps keep people’s conversations confidential, and discussion in the chat does get deleted in 24 hours.
blocks.body: Making people available by 24/7 to talk to a person, be it a different person studying psychology or a licensed professional therapist, was the best-in-class solution our development team provided to the client. It was utterly a real-time data task that we worked upon.

## Wireframe

Alerts and notifications are the ways through which users can be notified that someone from the group chats messaged or acknowledged his/her issue or concern.

All listeners are either studying psychology or are licensed therapists. All conversations are confidential and anonymous and gets deleted in 24 hours.
